subject: general
question: Dipti, Priti, Neeti, Reeti, Swati, Kirti and Jyoti are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. Dipti sits second to the right of Priti. Jyoti sits to the immediate left of Priti. Swati is an immediate neighbour of both Jyoti and Neeti. Reeti is an immediate neighbour of Priti. Who sits second to the left of Neeti?
solution:
Given: Dipti, Priti, Neeti, Reeti, Swati, Kirti and Jyoti are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

Dipti sits second to the right of Priti.

Jyoti sits to the immediate left of Priti.

Swati is an immediate neighbour of both Jyoti and Neeti.

Reeti is an immediate neighbour of Priti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c597df065035f09e9838e67e57b6246609e379f521921239591b2f8136a8cd9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19b6c7a2392a61db275621415fc48c4fa072461b2e02b403cec7e21669d79849.png] 

And Kirti sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c59c7c45387474dd72d4ef334877d00f421a11d9ad511c4779f809b8b6592fb.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ccdf9113c645933b2241dee674d7ad65b7110d55ea57076fe4b4140ea2e4f29.png] 

Dipti sits second to the left of Neeti.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
